## What and why

<!-- One concern per PR. Title follows Conventional Commits, e.g. `docs(spec): clarify budget semantics`. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Editorial (wording, typos, examples)
- [ ] Substantive specification change (link the issue)
- [ ] Breaking change (requires a new API version)
- [ ] Schemas, conformance tests, tooling or website

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO: `git commit -s`)
- [ ] YAML examples parse and match the normative text
- [ ] Normative key words (MUST/SHOULD/MAY) are used deliberately and in uppercase
- [ ] No vendor lock-in, no compliance claims, no secrets or real personal data
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
